Main scene: A first-person human hand reaches in from the lower left foreground toward the character, slightly motion-blurred and out of focus. Center frame shows a small full-body anime girl standing on the rooftop, looking upward toward the camera. She has {argument name="hair color" default="pale blue"} bob-cut hair, long pointed elf ears, and an elaborate black-and-white gothic lolita maid outfit. Her face is covered by a large opaque gray censor square, centered over the upper face and nose area. Keep the character rendered in a crisp anime illustration style while the rooftop, hand, and lighting remain photorealistic, emphasizing the surreal contrast of an anime character physically present in a real livestream.

Character details: Use {argument name="character name" default="ちいカオスちゃん"} as the streamer name in the UI. The character wears exactly 12 visible outfit/accessory groups: 1) black maid headband with white frills, 2) black bow and flower ornaments on the hair, 3) red hair clip, 4) black choker with metal ring, 5) black-and-white ruffled maid dress, 6) white apron with bold text reading “CUTIE CHAOS”, 7) red hanging tag with Japanese characters, 8) black sleeve cuffs with patches, 9) small cross and skull-like accessories, 10) layered black skirt with blue trim, 11) asymmetrical knee socks, and 12) chunky platform shoes with straps and red-blue accents.

TikTok live UI layout: Add a complete mobile livestream interface overlay. Top left shows the time “13:47”. Under it, a rounded streamer card with a circular anime avatar, the name “ちいカオスちゃん”, viewer count “12.8K”, and a pink rounded “+ フォロー” button. Below that, show a flame icon and “日間ランキング1位”. Top right shows Wi-Fi/battery icons, two small circular viewer avatars, a person icon with “999”, and an X close icon. Mid-right top shows “他の配信を見る >” and a promo tile reading “TikTok LIVE FEST” with “Japan” beneath it and a colorful TikTok logo.

Right-side action rail: Include exactly 7 stacked action elements from top to bottom: 1) circular profile avatar with a pink plus badge, 2) white heart icon with “12.8K”, 3) comment bubble with “256”, 4) bookmark icon with “1,024”, 5) share arrow with “304”, 6) bottom share-style arrow with “128”, and 7) a row of gift/navigation icons near the bottom labeled “マルチ...”, “バラ”, and “ギフト”.

items.title: Anime Ensemble Movie Poster
items.prompt: A meticulously crafted poster for a Japanese animated feature film, presented vertically in a single sheet format, rendered with high-end cinematic detail and bright natural light. The composition features a dramatic group portrait of six teenagers against a backdrop of a bright blue sky, soft clouds, distant white birds, shimmering water, and lush vegetation in the foreground. The left side of the background depicts the ruins of a futuristic eco-city, partially covered by vegetation, seamlessly blending nature with advanced science. At the top center, two main characters stand back-to-back, serving as the visual focal point: on the left is a tall boy with messy short white hair, pale skin, a calm and serious expression, wearing a shirt, tie, and white lab coat, turned to the left; on the right is a tall girl with black hair neatly styled in a bun, pale skin, a composed expression, wearing a dark school uniform-style outfit with a white collar and ribbon, turned to the right. In the foreground below them stands a female student with a straight black bob, pale skin, wearing a black uniform with a large dark red bow, facing forward, her expression quiet and reserved. To the left center stands a dark-haired boy, wearing a dark suit and tie, turned to the left. To the right center stands a boy with messy brown hair, wearing a blue hoodie under a dark jacket, turned to the right. To the lower left stands a girl with long, soft light brown hair, wearing a light pink cardigan over a light-colored top, one hand on her chest, her expression gentle yet slightly anxious. The anatomy of each character is consistent and clearly defined, hair is rendered elegantly, clothing folds are delicate, and expressions are restrained yet emotional. Warm rim lighting and soft atmospheric glow, complemented by delicate lens flare and oil painting-like highlights, create an atmosphere full of hope and contemplation. Japanese typography design is incorporated into the poster: the vertical slogan in the upper left corner is "その选択が, the scenery of the future を変える.", and the vertical slogan in the upper right corner is "Natural と, Science と、心をつなぐ路へ", the small characters above the title are "Theatre アニメーション影视", and the large luminous main title is in the center below.{argument name="film title" default="エコテイクノート"} The subtitle is below the title.{argument name="subtitle text" default="— A choice for the future —"} Below the title are three award laurel wreaths displayed horizontally, containing a small Japanese film festival text. Above the cast and crew list at the bottom are six character name tags displayed horizontally. At the very bottom is a dense Japanese cast and crew list, with minimal social media and website information. The release date is prominently displayed in the lower right corner.{argument name="release date" default="8.22 FRI"} Below this is a smaller line of text: "National Roadshow".
